recipes.title: Fat-Loss Protein Cinnamon Roll (Egg White Roll)

items.i: liquid or powdered sweetener, to taste
cinnamon and a pinch of salt
cinnamon and a touch of salt

steps: Beat the egg whites with the vanilla and sweetener until stiff.
Spread on a lined baking sheet, sprinkle with cinnamon and salt and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8–10 minutes until set and lightly golden.
Mix the cream cheese, yogurt, vanilla and powdered sweetener until smooth.
Spread the filling over the baked sheet and roll it up gently.
Dust with cinnamon and powdered sweetener. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's (fibre ~2 g). Original recipe by @madelainerascan.
